offsides goal.  Galoppo passes up the center.  Embolo holds up his run and breaks.  He is on his own with the keeper.  Embolo chips the keeper and it goes in.  Then the AR raises his flag.  Embolo was off on the initial pass.
Alonso carring the ball into Toronto's half.  He has time to hold the ball without being pressured.  Atlanta are able to press forward, but end up putting it out for a goal kick.
Díaz is the CB doing the most distribution.

Almirón carries the ball forward, runs central, then passes back to Báez who is running up the wing.  His cross goes over everyone.  This sums up the game so far, for both teams.  Niether can get the ball to their front line.
Atlanta doing really well from the back line to midfield..  Passing, triangles, runs - all working.  It just cannot provide the ball to the front line.  Bad passes, over hits, giveaways, etc.

Atlanta goal.  Almirón dribbling the ball on the right wing.  Cuts back and goes central. passes to Sanchez, he deflects to Miranchuk.  Almirón continues his run and asks for it.  Miranchuk passes up to Almirón.  He chased by a CB, and the keeper rushes out.  It's a short race.  Miggy slides forward and gets his foot to it.  He megs the keeper to get the goal.
Miggy runs to the corner and boxes the flag.
Atlanta have increased the pace of play.  Runs and passing are noticeably faster.
Toronto break - Embolo tracks all the way back to the 18 to help out and try to win the ball back.
Feels like the midfield were instructed to play throughballs, and the front line got different instructions.  On a completely different game plan.
Toronto 🟨.  Miranchuk with a spin move sees Jacob running up the pitch.  Jacob dribbles in Toronto's half, gets about 30 yards when Sallói knocks him over from behind.  Professional foul.
Miranchuk has been having a great game so far.

Almirón strips Toronto of the ball, hits a nice through ball up for Jacob.  he carries it forward before crossing to the left wing for Miranchuk.  He sends it central to a rushing Almirón.  But Toronto is there, slides in and clears.

Atlanta goal.  Báez hits a long ball over the top behind Toronto's line.  For all accounts, the ball looked like it was going to go out of bounds.  Toronto let it.  Almirón ran after it.  He gets the ball at the sideline and keeps it in. He brings it forward and starts his run towards the box.  Embolo kept up his run and was there.  Running from deep is Sanchez, he's calling for it.  Almirón sees him and passes to the top of the 18.  Sanchez hits it one touch to the right side of the net.  Really nice composed finish from Cooper.  He runs over to the corner flag to celebrate.

Player Impressions:
Hoyos - has had one big save 🧤 where he stood firm to prevent a hard shot
Jacob - making all kinds of moves to transition from defense to run up the pitch and act as a conduit
Díaz - the main playmaker from the back.  Doing what needs to be done defensively as well
Alonso - hasn't stood out
Báez - doing a good job, not great.  Trying to make things happen.
Sanchez - acting as a playmaker.  His supporting run for Miggy allowed for the goal
Amaro - doing pretty well as a DM.  Preventing Toronto from having any kind of luck in the middle.  Is quick to act as a CB when needed
Galoppo - underwhelming game so far
Miranchuk - the team's main playmaker.  Has license to try very difficult passes.  Trying to make things happen
Almirón - His usual level of physical play.  Chasing down everything.  He was the one player that recognized a chance to get the ball to setup the goal
Embolo - By no fault of his own, cannot get onto the front of a ball.  He's putting in the work.  Feel like one is coming for him.

Player Impressions:
Hoyos - did what he had to do without being spectactular
Jacob - one of his better performances.  didn't put a foot wrong
Díaz - got into good positions, broke up several Toronto plays.  
Alonso - didn't stand out, was beaten a few times.  Doesn't have it anymore
Báez - did really well for most of the game.  Toronto figured him out late and started overloading his corner.  He relied on going to ground when he shouldn't have
Sanchez - Atlanta's best player on the night.  dominated midfield.  good eye on his distribution.  owned midfield out of possession
Amaro - Toronto couldn't get a foothold centrally as long as he was on the pitch.  He is going ot be a force for the team going forward.
Galoppo - couldn't make an impact for the team tonight
Miranchuk - the team's offensive playmaker.  HeHis eye was on target, he was trying a lot of difficult plays 
Almirón - same performance.  extremely hard working both in defense and offense.   is all over the pitch.  He alone saw that he could get the ball which setup a goal
Embolo - I really like everything he does, he just cannot get a goal.
